research_scope: Gilbert, Arizona candidate projects rejected from the qualified file because the source did not establish both a current/recent signal and an actual builder/general contractor, or because it was plainly stale. Retained to prevent unsupported assignments.

rejected_or_uncertain_results.project_location: Gilbert Advocacy Center Phase 1, Civic Center Drive and American Heroes Way, Gilbert, Arizona
